title: Lesson Plan — Oceans and Continents (Class 6 CBSE Social Science)
subject: Social Science
objectives: State the approximate proportions of land and water on Earth.
Name the seven continents in order of size.
Name the five oceans and their rough positions.
Match major features (Sahara, Amazon, Himalayas) to their continents.
Identify the oceans bordering each continent.
Locate India in Asia and identify its bordering seas and the role of the Tropic of Cancer.
prerequisites: Chapter 1 — latitude, longitude, equator, Tropic of Cancer.
Familiarity with reading a world map.
materials: Coloured stickers / sticky-notes for marking features
Blank world map for students to label continents and oceans

activities.description: Show a globe / large world map. Ask: 'Which colour covers more of the Earth — blue or brown?' Discuss briefly that water covers most of the Earth's surface.
Pair activity: students point to the seven continents and the five oceans on the world map. They write down the order of continents from largest to smallest based on what they observe.
teacher_actions: Verify the order with each pair.

activities.description: Cover three blocks: (i) the seven continents — order, key features, climate; (ii) the five oceans — their positions and special facts; (iii) India in the world — its location in Asia, oceans around it, neighbours, Tropic of Cancer through the middle.
teacher_actions: Mark each continent on the board map.
Drill the order: Asia, Africa, NA, SA, Antarctica, Europe, Australia.
Show oceans and which continents each borders.
student_actions: Pair-quiz each other on continent / ocean facts.

activities.description: Worksheet: 5 questions (naming, ordering, matching, India-specific question, comparison).
Exit-ticket: 4 quick questions covering each block.
Set homework: label a blank world map with all 7 continents, 5 oceans, and India's position.

homework: Label a blank world map with all 7 continents, all 5 oceans, and clearly mark India.
Write 3 sentences describing your home state's position: which continent? near which ocean? in which heat zone?
Find one famous landmark from each of three different continents and note its country.
assessment_ideas: Use the 4-item exit ticket as formative.
Mark the LONG_ANSWER on choosing a continent to visit using a structured rubric.
references: NCERT Class 6 Social Science — Exploring Society: India and Beyond, Chapter 2: Oceans and Continents.
